summary: Iteration 84 - Dynamic Irregular Administrative Flow for Quotes. Backend APIs tested and working: GET /api/quotes/irregular/count, GET /api/quotes/audit-log, POST approve/collect/deliver with x-exception-reason headers. Frontend verified: Irregular widget with count, orange 'Irregular' badge on quotes, '!' indicators on dropdown actions, Exception Protocol Modal with reason textarea and date input. Fixed routing order issue for audit-log endpoint. Added is_irregular and irregular_exceptions fields to Quote model.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Swapped router order (quote_actions_router before quotes_router) to fix /quotes/audit-log route conflict
/app/backend/models.py - Added is_irregular and irregular_exceptions fields to Quote model
seed_data_creation: Quote COT-2026-03-069-TBP marked as irregular with exceptions from previous test runs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 84 complete - Dynamic Irregular Administrative Flow. Key findings: 1) GET /api/quotes/irregular/count returns count of quotes with is_irregular=true. 2) GET /api/quotes/audit-log returns audit_exceptions collection entries. 3) POST /api/quotes/{id}/approve|collect|deliver require x-exception-reason header when status doesn't match expected (irregular flow). 4) Frontend shows irregular widget with count > 0 (data-testid='irregular-widget'). 5) Orange 'Irregular' badge on quotes marked irregular (data-testid='irregular-badge-{id}'). 6) Dropdown actions (Aprobar, Facturar, Cobrar, Entregar) show '!' indicator when action would be irregular. 7) Exception Protocol Modal (data-testid='exception-modal') appears with reason textarea (data-testid='exception-reason'), date input (data-testid='exception-regularization-date'), and confirm button (data-testid='exception-confirm-btn') disabled until reason is filled.

backend_audit_log.returns: array of audit entries with audit_id, quote_id, action, expected_status, actual_status, exception_reason

backend_approve_irregular.irregular_flow: Returns 422 with IRREGULAR prefix when status != Enviada and no x-exception-reason header

backend_collect_irregular.irregular_flow: Returns 422 with IRREGULAR prefix when status != Facturada and no x-exception-reason header

backend_deliver_irregular.irregular_flow: Returns 400 when quote is not equipment type, 422 with IRREGULAR prefix when status != Pagada
